name: Barbarian
description: A fierce warrior who can enter a battle rage.

name: Bard
description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

name: Cleric
description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

name: Druid
description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature.

name: Fighter
description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armour.

name: Monk
description: A master of martial arts, harnessing inner power.

name: Paladin
description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath.

name: Ranger
description: A warrior who combats threats on the edges of civilisation.

name: Rogue
description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles.

name: Sorcerer
description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

name: Warlock
description: A wielder of magic derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity.

name: Wizard
description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality.
